mode: image2image (vanilla CSFF card art as style reference)
prompt:
Use the attached reference images, each for one purpose.
Reference image 1 is the vanilla game's own block of ice (from Card Survival: Fantasy Forest): match its rendering exactly, the same teal-blue ice colour and the same way the ice is painted with flat patches of lighter and darker teal and thin dark outlines.
Reference image 2 is the COMPOSITION: keep this subject and pose (a sitting fox carved from ice), redrawn in reference image 1's style and ice colour.
Subject: an ice sculpture: a block of teal-blue ice carved into a sitting fox with two pointed ears and its tail curled around its front paws, the carving simple and slightly rough with flat chisel facets, a few small drips of melt at the base.
Style: flat posterized colour fills in a few tonal steps of teal and pale blue-white, cel-like, no soft gradients, no watercolour bleed, no paper texture; thin dark ink outlines; realistic proportions; nothing glossy, no sparkles, no glow.
Single subject centred with a generous white margin on a solid flat pure white background (#FFFFFF) filling every edge, no ground shadow, no scenery. No text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: watercolour, glass crystal, sparkles, lens flare, transparent see-through rendering, real fox with fur, orange colour, snow ground, puddle, pedestal, photo, 3D render, scenery behind the subject, grey background, off-white background, checkerboard.
note: Owner-approved 2026-10-10 in the Card Art Restyle Review (restyle toward vanilla card art). Finished by /process-card-art.
